review_candidates.description: Overview The Data Engineer is responsible for the administration, support, and optimization of enterprise database platforms and data solutions. This role designs, implements, and maintains reliable, scalable, and secure database environments while supporting data processing, automation, and operational excellence initiatives. The position provides technical expertise for MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, and PostgreSQL platforms, ensuring system availability, performance, and lifecycle management through upgrades, migrations, performance tuning, and modernization efforts. The role partners with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to deliver resilient database services that support business objectives and technology transformation initiatives. This position is eligible for the TalentQuest employee referral program. If an employee referred you for this job, please apply using the system-generated link that was sent to you. Responsibilities Administer, maintain, and support MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, and PostgreSQL database environments. Perform database upgrades, migrations, patching, and lifecycle management activities. Monitor and optimize database performance, availability, capacity, and reliability. Design and implement automation solutions to reduce manual operational tasks and improve efficiency. Support database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions. Troubleshoot production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions. Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, and application teams to support database services. Develop and maintain database standards, operational procedures, and technical documentation. Support database deployments across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Participate in operational support activities and on-call rotations as required. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Experience administering and supporting enterprise database platforms, including MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, and PostgreSQL. Experience with database upgrades, migrations, performance tuning, and lifecycle management. Knowledge of Linux operating systems and database infrastructure administration. Experience with scripting and automation tools such as Python, Shell, Ansible, or similar technologies. Understanding of database replication, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and high-availability architectures. Experience supporting databases in cloud, containerized, or hybrid infrastructure environments. Familiarity with PostgreSQL ecosystem tools, including EDB, CloudNativePG, OpenShift, and Kubernetes, preferred. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across multiple technical teams. review_candidates.title: Presales Solution Engineer
review_candidates.description: Presales Solution Engineer 基本情報 / Basic Info 勤務地 / Location ：東京、日本（国内在籍・日本頻出張可） / Tokyo, Japan (Domestic base with frequent Japan business trips acceptable) 報告先 / Reporting Line ：日本・亚太售前技術責任者 / Japan & APAC Presales Technical Lead 経験年数 / Experience Requirement ：光発電・蓄電池業界ソリューション営業技術経験5年以上 / More than 5 years of presales solution experience in PV & energy storage industry 担当業務 / Business Scope ：日本住宅・産業用蓄電システム、太陽光インバーター、光蓄統合システム、系統対応・補助金対応ソリューション / Residential & commercial ESS, PV inverter, PV&ESS integrated system, grid-compliant & subsidy-compliant solutions 職務内容 / Job Responsibilities 【日本語】 1. 日本市場向け光蓄製品の售前技術サポートを専門に担当し、営業チームと連携し、顧客の技術ニーズヒアリング、現場条件調査、システム方案設計、技術提案書・見積書作成を行う。 2. 日本の系統連系基準、電力会社ルール、ZEH・GX補助金政策、JC-STAR・VPP対応要求を熟知し、現地適合した住宅・産業用光蓄システムソリューションを策定し、方案の合规性・実行可能性・経済性を保障する。 3. 顧客（商社・EPC・デベロッパー・エンドユーザー）向け技術説明、製品デモ、技術Q&A、入札技術対応を担当し、技術面で案件獲得を支援する。 4. プロジェクト初期技術検証、機器選定、容量設計、発電・蓄電シミュレーション、投資回収シミュレーションを実施し、最適化されたシステム方案と技術パラメータを提供する。 5. 現地競合製品の技術特徴、方案優劣、価格体系を分析し、競争優位の技術提案・差別化方案を作成。本部製品・R&Dチームに日本市場の技術要求、改善提案をフィードバックする。 6. 受注後、技術引渡し資料を整理し、生産・サプライチェーン・現場施工チームと技術連携を行い、設計意図の正確な落地を保障。必要に応じて現地技術立会・試運転サポートを実施する。 7. 日本市場向け技術資料、カタログ、提案テンプレート、FAQを整備・更新し、チームの售前標準化能力を向上させる。 【English】 1. Responsible for end-to-end presales technical support for PV & ESS products in the Japanese market. Cooperate with sales teams to conduct demand analysis, site condition evaluation, system solution design, technical proposal drafting and quotation preparation. 2. Fully comply with Japanese grid connection standards, power utility regulations, ZEH/GX subsidy policies, JC-STAR and VPP technical requirements. Develop localized and compliant residential & commercial PV&ESS solutions to ensure technical feasibility, policy compliance and economic benefits. 3. Provide professional technical presentations, product demos, technical Q&A and bidding document support for customers including trading companies, EPCs, developers and end users, supporting deal closure from the technical dimension. 4. Conduct pre-project technical verification, equipment selection, system capacity configuration, power generation & energy storage simulation and ROI analysis, and deliver optimized system solutions and technical parameters. 5. Analyze competitor technical features, solution advantages and pricing strategies, formulate differentiated and competitive technical proposals, and feed back localized technical optimization requirements to product and R&D teams. 6. Sort out technical handover documents after order confirmation, coordinate with production, supply chain and construction teams to ensure accurate project implementation. Provide on-site technical guidance and commissioning support when necessary. 7. Compile and update Japanese-version technical documents, catalogs, proposal templates and FAQs to standardize and improve the team’s presales capability. 応募資格 / Job Requirements 【日本語】 1. 学士以上、電気工学、新エネルギー、自動制御、電力系統など関連専門。 太陽光・蓄電池業界售前ソリューション経験5年以上 、日本光蓄市場対応経験者優先。 2. 日本語N1、ビジネス技術会話・資料読解・作成が流暢、単独で顧客技術商談・入札対応可能。中国語業務可、英語読み書き優先。 3. 太陽光インバーター、住宅・産業用蓄電システム、エネルギーマネジメントシステムを熟知。日本系統ルール、補助金制度、製品認証要件を理解し、実務設計・提案経験保有者。 4. システム方案設計、機器选型、シミュレーション計算、見積作成能力に優れ、複数の日本現地光蓄案件の售前落地実績がある方優先。 5. 優れた論理思考、顧客ニーズ把握、跨部門連携能力を有し、緊急案件・複雑技術問題に対応できる。日本頻出張可能。 6. CAD、PVsyst、エネルギーシミュレーションツール、Officeツール熟练者優先。 【English】 1. Bachelor’s degree or above, major in electrical engineering, new energy, automatic control, power system or related fields. Minimum 5 years of PV & ESS presales solution engineering experience ; candidates with Japanese market project experience are highly preferred. 2. JLPT N1 certified, fluent in technical Japanese communication, document reading and writing, capable of independent technical negotiation and bidding response. Mandarin for daily work; English reading and writing is a plus. 3. Proficient in PV inverters, residential & commercial energy storage systems and EMS. Familiar with Japanese grid codes, subsidy policies and product certification requirements with practical solution design experience. 4. Skilled in system solution design, equipment selection, energy simulation and quotation preparation. Proven experience in Japanese local PV&ESS project presales delivery is preferred. 5. Strong logical thinking, customer demand insight and cross-department collaboration ability; capable of handling urgent tasks and complex technical issues; accept frequent business trips to Japan. 6. Proficient in CAD, PVsyst, energy simulation tools and Microsoft Office is preferred.
